{{Quote|You never told me we'd be tracking a Sith...|Hirosho's last words|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Hirosho''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Agent who served in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Hirosho and his team were responsible for tracking [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice's]] personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] by orders of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]], but were eventually exposed.

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]] became aware of [[Darth Baras]] acquiring a new [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]]. Hirosho was assigned among a number of other technicians and Republic soldiers to maintain an orbital listening post and to track the apprentice's ship throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], though Karr withheld the identity of their target.

{{GameDS}}
However, the listening station's subterfuge did not go unnoticed for long, as Baras discovered its existence and sent his apprentice to put an end to its operation. The [[Sith Warrior]] eventually reached the command center, and though Karr pleaded for the lives of Hirosho and his team, the apprentice showed no mercy and killed all of them.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the choice of either executing (dark side dialogue) or sparing (light side dialogue) Hirosho and his men.
